title: Engineering standup (3 speakers)

segments.speaker: Lena
segments.text: Quick standup. The Android build failed again last night on the Bluetooth pairing test.

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.text: That's the flaky test. I'll quarantine it and open a ticket to fix the timeout.

segments.speaker: Jess
segments.text: Firmware 2.3 is ready for beta. I'll roll it out to the internal testers today.

segments.speaker: Lena
segments.text: Jess, could you also write the release notes for the beta?

segments.speaker: Omar
segments.text: Heads up, the transcription queue backed up yesterday afternoon. Latency hit forty seconds.

segments.speaker: Lena
segments.text: Let's add an alert when queue latency goes above twenty seconds. I'll set that up.

summary:
## Summary
- Lena reported the Android build failed on the Bluetooth pairing test.
- Omar said the transcription queue latency hit forty seconds.
- Jess will quarantine the flaky test.
## Action items
- Jess: roll out firmware 2.3 to internal testers.
- Omar: write the release notes for the beta.
- Lena: add an alert when queue latency goes above twenty seconds.
- Omar: migrate the queue to Kafka.
